notes: Collect Sampling Data applies to containers outside a sampling lot.
Counted inspections record samples collected and reject counts by configured reason; enter each rejected sample once.
Measured inspections enter each sample and data point; one or several failed points count as one failed sample (also verified in SampleTest EDM).
Sample test configuration can cause container quantity reductions; move constraints and automatic move are part of the modeled sampling process.
Current required/tested/failed counts come from MES; do not invent AQL tables or infer a final release decision.

implementation_limitations: Counted submissions support a single configured reject reason per plan.
Measured submissions support literal numeric limits only; final MES result is not established by this local precheck.
No sampling-lot submission, automatic quantity disposition, or automatic event creation in this implementation.
